grades.name: Edge
grades.rule: Sharpe beats holding the same coin at the same average exposure, after costs.
grades.measured: Sharpe 0.38 vs 1.07 for holding; return -61% vs +1009% at the same exposure

grades.name: Luck
grades.rule: Deflated Sharpe at least 95%, counting every trial.

grades.name: Out of sample
grades.rule: Walk-forward: most test windows still beat exposure-matched holding.
grades.measured: Beat holding in 0 of 7 test windows

grades.name: Start dates
grades.rule: Beats exposure-matched holding in at least 50% of 2-year start windows.
grades.measured: Better Sharpe than holding in 10% of 41 windows

grades.name: Costs
grades.rule: Break-even cost at least 2x the actual cost.
grades.measured: No profit before costs to absorb them

grades.name: Robustness
grades.rule: Neighbouring settings also pass the edge test.
grades.measured: 0% of 17 neighbouring settings beat holding (80% needed)

grades.name: Random entry
grades.rule: Bracket strategies: net expectancy per trade beats at least 95% of random-entry paths with the same stops, targets and sizing.
grades.measured: Holds weights, not brackets: no payoff shape to copy.
